name: dsh-pet-shura
description: 修罗小脑斧 — animated desktop pet for the dsh web surface: v2 spritesheet animation, drag & drop, look-at-mouse, settings panel, speech bubble reporting live work, and a thread-status card (double-click or right-click → 线程状态) listing every busy session's current tool. Engineer-toned concise line bank; wide flat notice-bar bubble aligned with the DSH quota card.
